About Football World 27

Lead your club in a full 11v11 football match with a broadcast camera and real match rules. Play a Quick Match, win the FW Cup, climb the World League, build a dream squad from packs, manage a clubs transfers and budget, or start a player career from the academy to the first team.

How to play

Move with WASD or the arrow keys J passes K shoots L plays a through ball I lobs and Shift sprints every key can be changed in Settings Esc pauses the match On phones use the joystick and the on-screen buttons
